# Spendwise — AI Crawler Policy
# https://llmstxt.org

> Spendwise is a free web app for personal expense tracking, OCR receipt scanning, and budget management.

## About

Spendwise helps individuals track expenses, scan receipts using Tesseract OCR, visualize spending trends, and manage monthly budgets. It is free forever with no credit card required.

## Allowed

All AI crawlers and large language model training data collection is permitted on public pages (/, /privacy, /terms).

## Disallowed

Crawling of authenticated user data pages (/dashboard, /expenses, /analytics, /receipts) is not permitted as these contain personal financial data.
